# RANKUE (랭큐)

> RANKUE is a billiards skill-rating and matchmaking app. It measures a player's
> skill as an RP (Rating Point) score, automatically records matches, finds
> skill-matched rivals and crews, and provides venue and nationwide rankings for
> 3-cushion and 4-ball (carom) billiards. Available on iOS and Android, free to use,
> in Korean, English, Vietnamese, Turkish, and Spanish.

## What RANKUE is

RANKUE (랭큐) is a mobile app for billiards players. Instead of vague self-reported
handicaps, RANKUE gives every player an objective RP rating that rises and falls with
real match results — separately for 3-cushion and 4-ball. Players use it to track their
skill over time, get matched against opponents of similar level, keep automatic score
records, join crews (clubs), and climb store and national leaderboards.

## Key features

- **RP rating**: An objective billiards skill score (separate for 3-cushion and 4-ball) that updates with win/loss results.
- **Skill matchmaking (매칭 대결)**: 1:1 ranked matches against opponents of similar RP. PIN-code entry lets an opponent join the same game.
- **Automatic match records (기록)**: Every official match is recorded — innings, high run, average, and RP changes.
- **Crews (크루)**: Create or join billiards clubs, share activity and photos, chat, and manage members.
- **Simulator (시뮬레이터)**: A solo on-screen virtual billiards table for 3-ball / 4-ball practice.
- **Rankings (랭킹)**: Store-level and nationwide leaderboards for 3-cushion and 4-ball.

## Facts

- Name: RANKUE (Korean: 랭큐)
- Category: Sports / Billiards app
- Platforms: iOS, Android, Web (PWA)
- Price: Free
- Languages: Korean (ko), English (en), Vietnamese (vi), Turkish (tr), Spanish (es)
- Disciplines: 3-cushion carom, 4-ball carom
- Website: https://www.rankue.co.kr
